text: BAM share rose 1.43 percentage points over 24 hours and 1.26 percentage points over 7 days, reaching 35.9% of Solana stake. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-1-tee holds 25.2% of BAM stake and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The 66 top-node leadership changes in this window are best read as whale-driven routing, while only one structural rollover has been validated.
